stem.en: What is the geometric relationship between a plane and its normal vector?
stem.et: Milline on geomeetriline seos tasandi ja selle normaalvektori vahel?

label.en: The normal is perpendicular to every vector lying in the plane
label.et: Normaal on risti iga tasandis asuva vektoriga

label.en: The normal lies in the plane, pointing along its longest direction
label.et: Normaal asub tasandis, osutades selle pikima suuna poole

label.en: The normal is unique, so each plane has exactly one
label.et: Normaal on ainus, seega on igal tasandil täpselt üks

label.en: The normal is parallel to any line that fails to meet the plane
label.et: Normaal on paralleelne iga sirgega, mis tasandit ei lõika
